summary.text: Chad Boyer is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 46, representing St. Landry and St. Martin, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Chad Boyer's occupation as Director of Safety, Coburn Supply Company Inc..
It lists Chad Boyer's education as St. Martinville High School.

The House member page lists Chad Boyer's committee assignments as Administration of Criminal Justice; Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development; Transportation, Highways and Public Works; Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Capitol Security Council.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation (Vice Chair); Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
